feature: Certification of Qualifications for Membership of the Thai Kao Mai Party
featureSubTitle: I hereby certify that I possess all the required qualifications and do not fall under any of the prohibitions under Section 24 of the Political Party Act B.E. 2560 (2017) and the Thai Kao Mai Party Regulations B.E. 2568 (2025). I hereby certify as follows:
feature1: I am not insane, mentally unstable, or mentally unfit.
feature2: I am not a drug addict.
feature3: I do not hold any position as a monk, novice, ascetic, or priest.
feature4: I do not hold any position as a monk, novice, ascetic, or priest.
feature5: I am not a senator, or a former senator whose membership has terminated within the past 2 years.
feature6: I am not bankrupt or have been a dishonest bankrupt.
feature7: I am not a member, applicant for registration, or informant of preparations for the establishment of another political party.
feature8: I have not engaged in any behavior that is clearly contrary to the party's ideology.
feature9: I am not currently prohibited from holding political office, have had my right to stand for election temporarily suspended, or have had my right to stand for election revoked. Enlist in the election regardless of whether the case is final.
feature10: Never been convicted of electoral fraud.
feature11: Never been dismissed from office for reasons under Section 144 (fraudulent allocation of funds in the consideration of the national budget law) or Section 235, paragraph three (fraudulent holding of a political office) of the Constitution.
feature12: Never been sentenced to imprisonment for a term less than 10 years as of the date of application for membership, except for offenses committed through negligence or minor offenses.
feature13: Never been sentenced to imprisonment and detained by a court order.
feature14: Never been dismissed from government service, a government agency, or a state enterprise for corruption or for being deemed to have committed corruption or misconduct in the public service.
feature15: Never been sentenced by a final judgment for malfeasance in office or malfeasance in office, or for malfeasance in office, or for offenses related to property committed through corruption under the Criminal Code. Except in cases where the sentence is suspended.
feature16: Never been sentenced to imprisonment by a final judgment for committing an offense under the law on fraudulent loans to the public, the law on narcotics for being a manufacturer, importer, exporter, or dealer, the law on gambling for being a bookmaker or office owner, the law on prevention and suppression of human trafficking, or the law on prevention and suppression of money laundering for money laundering.
feature17: Never been sentenced by a final judgment or court order forfeiting assets to the state due to unusual wealth, or never been sentenced to imprisonment by a final judgment for committing an offense under the law on prevention and suppression of corruption.

I hereby consent to the Party Member Registrar having the authority to inspect and access my personal information under the control of government agencies.
